payload.title: Plain editor-facing copy in the embedded status strip and decision line
payload.description: Requirement from Ryan (product owner): editors using an embedding app (Papyrus References) should not see engine concepts. They add references and review suggestions; learning stays implicit. In the embedded components (PrimingPanel, CyclotronStatusView strip and card, ReviewControl decision line, HeldOutReportView) replace editor-facing jargon: no versions, calibration, onboarding, priming, cyclotron, classifier or sweep in user-visible strings. Status strip must not show 'Version N', 'Calibration not measured yet' or 'Onboarding'. Decision line becomes 'Suggested: include (82% sure)' with no version. 'Add a reference' is the editor's mental model for a labeled example. Constraints: change only user-visible strings plus minimal logic to hide version/calibration; do not rename props, types, exports, API fields or GraphQL/Python names; embedding apps need only a version bump. The lab/operator UI (ClassifierMetrics, MultiLabelCard, lab LabelingReview, cycle-timeline, lab-metrics, brand) keeps technical terms.
